assignment_shape.value: ("admin_assignments"."scope_type" = 'school' AND "admin_assignments"."grade" IS NULL AND "admin_assignments"."class_id" IS NULL AND "admin_assignments"."subject" IS NULL) OR ("admin_assignments"."scope_type" = 'grade' AND "admin_assignments"."grade" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_assignments"."grade" IN (7,8,9) AND "admin_assignments"."class_id" IS NULL AND "admin_assignments"."subject" IS NULL) OR ("admin_assignments"."scope_type" IN ('class', 'homeroom') AND "admin_assignments"."class_id" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_assignments"."grade" IS NULL AND "admin_assignments"."subject" IS NULL) OR ("admin_assignments"."scope_type" = 'teaching_subject' AND "admin_assignments"."class_id" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_assignments"."grade" IS NULL AND "admin_assignments"."subject" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_assignments"."subject" IN ('CHINESE','ENGLISH','MATH','SCIENCE','GEOGRAPHY','HISTORY','CIVICS'))

ai_job_lease.name: ai_job_lease
